abstract: A 7-year-old boy reported with endodermal sinus tumor of left testis, jejunal metastasis and intestinal obstruction. He was treated by high inguinal orchidectomy and resection of jejunal mass followed by chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 7歳の男児が、左精巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍、空腸転移、腸閉塞で受診した。高位鼠径精巣摘除術と空腸腫瘤の切除術を行い、その後化学療法を行った。
